results.message: How do I register for a LearningExpress Library account?
results.text:
To register for a free LearningExpress Library account, you can follow these steps:

1. Go to [WVinfodepot.org](http://WVinfodepot.org).
2. Click on "Databases A-Z" in the menu on the left.
3. Scroll down to "LearningExpress Library" and click the link.
4. On the registration screen, fill in your details to create your account.

You can find more details in this guide: [Registering for a Free LearningExpress Library Account](/api/documents/download?id=cmmyyaz7z002keadk6vq82g4b&mode=view).
